questions.question: difference between functions and procedures in sql
questions.answer: Functions return values; procedures perform actions without returning values in SQL.Functions can return a single value, e.g., `SELECT UPPER(name) FROM users;`Procedures do not return values but can perform operations, e.g., `CALL UpdateUser(1, 'John');`Functions can be used in SQL statements, while procedures cannot.Functions are often used for calculations, while procedures are used for executing business logic.

questions.question: Difference In Stack And Heap
questions.answer: Stack is for static memory allocation, while heap is for dynamic memory allocation in programming.Stack memory is managed automatically, while heap memory requires manual management.Stack has a fixed size, whereas heap can grow and shrink dynamically.Local variables are stored in the stack, while objects and arrays are stored in the heap.Example: In C++, 'int a;' is stack allocation, while 'int* b = new int[10];' is heap allocation.
